posts.title: Thank a feminist
posts.description: This year there is a change. This message is addressed to women, and only to them. For a start, if they try to give you a mimosa, tell them: thanks, but no, thanks. Make a salad with it. And then I invite you to learn more about what the feminist movement was and is, not the bullshit they tell you,... Read more »

posts.title: February
posts.description: January was three months long, but luckily February has arrived, which is usually shorter, or at least let's hope it will be. Big news there is none, but some smaller ones are.
